note: Solar installed capacity (GW). Each country takes whichever source's own latest point is more recent: Ember's Data API (monthly cadence, 32 countries) or the yearly generation CSV's own Capacity (GW) column (one point a year, wider coverage - no API equivalent exists for this one). A country's entry is either "granularity": "monthly" with a `series` of {year, month, gw} points, or "granularity": "annual" with an `annualSeries` of {year, gw} points - never both.
